name: malahor-ai
description: CLI local para potenciar agentes de IA con memoria persistente, vault Markdown, OpenCode, SDD y guardrails.

scripts.build: bun run build:plugin && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist --target=node && bun build src/mnemo/index.ts --outdir dist/mnemo --target=node && bun build src/docs/index.ts --outdir dist/docs --target=node && bun build src/horiel/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/horiel --target=node --external node:sqlite
scripts.dev:sandbox: bun run build && MALAHOR_HOME=.sandbox/home/.malahor MALAHOR_OPENCODE_DIR=.sandbox/home/.config/opencode node dist/index.js install --yes
scripts.context:sandbox: MALAHOR_HOME=.sandbox/home/.malahor MALAHOR_OPENCODE_DIR=.sandbox/home/.config/opencode bun run src/cli/index.ts context status
